phase_policy.phase1: core region construction sheets; must validate before expansion sheets are produced
phase_policy.phase2: safety-volume upper-layer expansion; D and E only after phase1 is proven

elyndor.reason: pastoral region with streams/water, village structures, roads, vegetation and broad prop coverage

crownweave.reason: dense civic highland architecture and gardens; animated water sheet not required for baseline

silkspire.reason: vertical urban architecture, bridges, workshops and structural props; no baseline animated water requirement

gloamfen.reason: wetland requires animated water plus boardwalk/shelter architecture and marsh props

verdancia.reason: living forest infrastructure, streams, bridges, root paths, vegetation and settlement props

tideglass-coast.reason: coastal region requires animated sea/waterfall capacity, cliffs, docks, buildings and maritime props

moonpatch-steppe.reason: open steppe, trails, camp structures and caravan props; animated water not required for baseline

sunspool-desert.reason: desert terrain, oasis water, salvage ruins, shelters and heat-region props

cinderreach.reason: volcanic terrain uses A1 animated liquid capacity for lava plus forge structures and industrial-fantasy props

frostlace.reason: ice/water animation capacity, frozen terrain, archive structures and cold-region props
